extractionNotes: Transcribed from Chip's four Island Fish Beach Company menu photos (QA fixture). Not generated by live AI.

UNVERIFIED vs a later reprint: photo 4's partially visible sushi/sashimi header showed different piece counts and prices than photo 3. Photo 3 is the source of truth for Sushi / Sashimi and Specialty Rolls.
UNVERIFIED: photo 3's bottom ROLLS column was cut off (prices $10 / $12 / $12 / $12 / $15). Names were not invented; regular rolls come from photo 4.
Names kept as printed, including Softty Po Boy, Sword Sandy, Margarita, Panseared, and Siracha tobiko.
